title: warp_mouse warping to center of screen when quickly changing between Input MOUSE_MODE_VISIBLE and MOUSE_MODE_CAPTURED
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in: 4.7.beta1, 4.6.2.stable
Not reproducible: Did not found a working version.


### System information

Godot v4.7.beta1 - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 3 monitors - Direct3D 12 (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 SUPER (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.8115) - AMD Ryzen 7 7800X3D 8-Core Processor (16 threads) - 63.05 GiB memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

Going from MOUSE_MODE CAPTURED to VISIBLE or CONFINED with warp_mouse will sometimes warp to the center of the screen when trying to warp to a previously saved mouse location.

This issue is game breaking and a common feature in games that utilize holding right click for camera movement. Example would be Roblox where a users camera direction is locked unless holding right click + moving mouse. In godot to get this equivalent infinite mouse movement without the cursor flying off the window we utilize captured.


### Steps to reproduce

Spam right click while moving mouse and see that sometimes it will teleport to the center of the screen and not restore back to where the cursor was previously.

It is easier to reproduce with an autoclicker but it can easily be done without one. I did not use an autoclicker in (1) but I did use one in (2)

Attached 2 videos below demonstrating the bug in the engine (1) and in a script (2)

Examples
1. Open an empty project. Goto 3D tab. ( Bug in the engine itself no GDScipt)
2. Create small 14 line GDScript and run a single scene with script attached. (Script in example project below)
